title: Configure the repositories through the UI
statement: As a developer, I can configure the target repository and set up the Saga repository through a UI so that establishing our self-hosted Change Saga is less confusing.
overview: Depends on self-hostable server mode. The target repository contains the application; the Saga repository holds its documentation. Creating a remote repository versus connecting or initializing one, credentials, and the completion check remain open.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The onboarding UI lets the user configure the target repository for the self-hosted Saga.
The onboarding UI lets the user set up the repository that will hold the Saga separately from the target repository.
